Regulatory Tracker
Digital-asset regulation in Indonesia and Singapore  ·  Data catalog

When a country moves crypto from its trade ministry to its financial regulator, what actually changes?

On 10 January 2025 Indonesia moved crypto oversight from Bappebti to the OJK. This tracker follows that question with real data: 45 months of transaction values, a dated timeline of every regulatory action, and an event study that reports its own failures. Nothing here is simulated.

Three findings, honestly stated

Just here for the story? These three findings tell you everything. Want to check my work? Everything downstream — charts, queries, raw CSVs — is open for exactly that.

Anyone can generate a dashboard with AI. What can't be generated: data reconciled against every published total, estimates that carry their own placebo tests, and a null result published anyway. That's the product.

The handover changed nothing detectable

Growth shifted +9.3% → −5.2% a month at the transfer — and the shift is not statistically significant. Placebo tests pass; the null is the finding.

The 2024 boom wasn't policy

The pre-transfer recovery tracked global crypto cycles with no control series needed to see it. Don't credit Bappebti's exit for what followed.

The region is racing

Six jurisdictions, four strategies: Singapore liberalises, Indonesia builds, Thailand cuts taxes, Vietnam legalises, the Philippines paused. Watch this space.
